title: Common denominators
subtitle: Explore the idea with a visual model.
learning_objective: Find a shared denominator for fractions with different-sized parts.

sections.heading: Make sense of it
sections.body: A common denominator names both fractions with the same-sized pieces. A common multiple of the denominators can be used.

sections.heading: Build a picture
sections.caption: Each row represents the same-sized whole.

sections.problem: Find a common denominator for 1/3 and 1/4.
sections.reasoning: Each step keeps the meaning of the whole and its equal parts clear.

sections.heading: Watch for this
sections.body: The product works, but the least common multiple often keeps numbers smaller.

sections.heading: Your turn
sections.prompt: What is the least common denominator of 1/2 and 1/5?
sections.hint: Use the visual and the worked steps above before choosing.
